blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – The University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars and the University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Junior Webmasters emerged as the winningest teams in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 badminton tournament, capturing six and five titles, respectively, over the weekend at the Duelo Battleground badminton courts. USJ-R dominated the collegiate division with six championships, while UCLM topped the secondary division with five titles. In the collegiate division, USJ-R ruled the women’s singles A, women’s doubles, men’s singles A and B, men’s doubles, and mixed doubles events. READ: Cesafi badminton: USJ-R, UCLM share 5 […]...
